The legend, located to the right, correlates each line with its respective variable as labeled in the image.

The lines on the graph show variations along the x-axis, indicating changes over the period or frequency represented. In contrast, 'Technology Imitation' (Программист-ремонт на автомобили и мотоколетах) and 'Electronic products" (Идентикою ценностей и рынков и обслуживанием обслуживания пользователей: рекламный и александровский) display much more modest changes, with slight deviations and peaks at various intervals. Overall, the graph illustrates disparities in growth and development across different sectors or initiatives, with a particular emphasis on the notable increase for 'Simplicity' and the relatively stable or minor fluctuations for the other categories.
